protocol.title: Droplet-Scale Estrogen Assays in Breast Tissue, Blood, and Serum
protocol.platform: Digital microfluidics (DMF / EWOD) on single-plate open-top electrode array
protocol.objective: Miniaturised, automated liquid-liquid extraction and quantification of estradiol from 1-uL clinical samples using DMF; replaces conventional 5-6 h biopsy-based methods requiring hundreds of mg of tissue
institutions: Donnelly Centre for Cellular and Biomolecular Research, University of Toronto
Department of Chemistry, University of Toronto
Institute of Medical Science, University of Toronto
Ontario Cancer Biomarker Network, MaRS Center
Samuel Lunenfeld Research Institute, Mount Sinai Hospital

device.configuration: Open-top; no top plate during sample drying; top plate affixed before solvent loading
reservoirs: Sample reservoir (blood, serum, tissue homogenate, or standard solution)

extraction_zone.description: Liquid-liquid extraction zone bounded by a photoresist wall separating isooctane pool from collection reservoir
extraction_zone.function: Allows methanol droplet to circulate within isooctane pool then be driven out toward collection reservoir after partitioning

lysing_solvent.function: Lyses cells and dissolves lipid/protein matrix to free steroid analytes

polar_extraction_solvent.name: Methanol
polar_extraction_solvent.function: Dissolves free steroids from dried lysate into polar phase

nonpolar_extraction_solvent.name: Isooctane (2,2,4-trimethylpentane)
nonpolar_extraction_solvent.function: Partitions away lipid-soluble interferents (e.g. porphyrin m/z 715, DNA helicase m/z 677) from polar estradiol-containing phase

elisa_diluent.name: Estrogen-free serum (ALPCO Diagnostics)
elisa_diluent.function: Matrix for ELISA calibration; samples resuspended for absorbance readout

estradiol_standard.function: Reference analyte for LC-MS/MS SRM calibration and ELISA recovery curves

method_1.name: Primary extraction method (used in most experiments)

steps.name: Sample loading and drying
steps.description: 1-uL aliquot of whole blood, serum, breast tissue homogenate, or estradiol standard solution positioned in sample reservoir. Standard solutions used immediately; blood, serum, and tissue samples allowed to dry on electrode surface before top plate is affixed.

steps.name: Lysis -- DCM/acetone wave
steps.description: Series of reservoir volumes of DCM/acetone (80:20 v/v) dispensed and driven dropwise by DMF to the dried sample. Each sub-droplet incubated until dry (~1 min per reservoir volume). Lyses cells and dissolves steroids.

steps.name: Methanol dissolution and isooctane liquid-liquid extraction
steps.description: Reservoir volume of methanol dispensed to dried lysate to dissolve steroids. Unit droplet (200-400 nL) of dissolved sample driven to isooctane pool and circulated for ~20 s to partition interferents into non-polar phase. Droplet then driven out of isooctane toward collection reservoir. Repeated until sample reservoir exhausted of methanol.

steps.name: Pooling and drying of extract
steps.description: All extract droplets pooled in collection reservoir and allowed to dry. Devices stored at -20 C. Immediately before analysis, each extract resolubilised in 30 uL methanol/DCM (2:1 v/v), dispensed to centrifuge tube, solvent evaporated, and residue reconstituted in medium specific for desired analysis.

method_2.name: ELISA recovery and precision method
method_2.description: Standard solution of estradiol in methanol (1 uL) positioned in sample reservoir. Top plate affixed; lysis and polar solvent reservoirs left empty. Single unit droplet (200 nL) dispensed, translated through isooctane, delivered to collection reservoir. Sample reservoir washed manually with methanol three times; fresh sample positioned; process repeated twice. Three extract droplets (~600 nL total) pooled and dried.

mass_spectrometry_direct.sample_prep: 5-uL sample dried and extracted by DMF (Method 1); extract reconstituted in 50 uL methanol/formic acid 0.1% (v/v)
mass_spectrometry_direct.control_prep: 5-uL aliquots dried and reconstituted in 50 uL methanol/formic acid 0.1%; sonicated 10 min; filtered
mass_spectrometry_direct.key_finding: Estradiol fragment m/z 183 absent in whole samples; dominant peak in DMF-extracted samples. Interferents m/z 178 (tyrosine), 677 (DNA helicase), 715 (porphyrin) suppressed after extraction.

lc_ms_ms_srm.column: Thermo Gold C18, 2.2 um, 2.1 mm ID x 50 mm (microbore)
samples_evaluated: Estradiol standard solution (1 uL, 2 mg/mL in methanol)
Breast tissue homogenate from postmenopausal breast cancer patient (400 mg in 1 mL DCM)
Whole blood from female volunteer (1 uL dried)

breast_tissue_result.patient: Postmenopausal breast cancer patient (different from MS patient)

breast_tissue.source: Apparently normal tissue adjacent to breast cancer tumors
breast_tissue.processing: Manual homogenisation in 1 mL DCM; 1-uL aliquot taken and dried; processed by DMF Method 1

blood_and_serum.processing: 1-uL aliquots dried directly on DMF device; processed by Method 1

clinical_samples.ethics: Mount Sinai Hospital and Ontario Tumor Bank Research Ethics Boards

steps.name: Sample loading and drying
steps.notes: 1-uL aliquot dispensed to sample reservoir; blood/serum/tissue allowed to dry ~1 min before top plate affixed and solvents loaded

steps.name: Lysis cycle 1 -- DCM/acetone
steps.operation: dispense + mix (electrode-driven translation and merge onto dried sample)
steps.notes: First of 3 representative lysis cycles (paper uses 9 x 1.1 uL or 5 x 2.2 uL); each cycle incubated to dryness

steps.name: Lysis cycle 3 -- DCM/acetone
steps.notes: Final lysis cycle; produces driedLysate variable for methanol dissolution

steps.name: Methanol dissolution and LLE -- extraction cycle 1
steps.operation: dispense + mix (dissolution) + dispense + mix (LLE) + heat (isooctane circulation)
steps.notes: Methanol dissolves steroids from lysate. Unit droplet driven into isooctane pool, circulated ~20 s (modelled as heat at 25c for 20s), then driven to collection reservoir. Partitions tyrosine, porphyrin, DNA helicase fragments into isooctane.

steps.name: Methanol dissolution and LLE -- extraction cycle 2
steps.operation: dispense + mix (dissolution) + dispense + mix (LLE) + heat (isooctane circulation)

steps.name: Methanol dissolution and LLE -- extraction cycle 3
steps.operation: dispense + mix (dissolution) + dispense + mix (LLE) + heat (isooctane circulation)
steps.notes: Final extraction cycle; extract merged with estrogen-free serum diluent for ELISA reconstitution

steps.name: Pooling, reconstitution, and drying
steps.notes: Pooled extract reconstituted in estrogen-free serum/methanol 4:1 before ELISA; room-temperature drying modelled as heat at 25c for 5m (300s)

steps.name: ELISA extraction QC detection
steps.notes: Abstracts ELISA plate reader readout (abs 450 nm). Pass condition: estradiol signal above background. Recovery 86-119%, CV 7-10% (Fig. 4).

steps.name: MS confirmation detection
steps.notes: 192 s abstracts LC-MS/MS SRM retention time (~3.2 min) plus nanoelectrospray equilibration. Estradiol standard dispensed as MS reference droplet. Module covers both LTQ direct-MS (m/z 183, negative mode) and QTRAP LC-MS/MS SRM (m/z 271/145).

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Sample loading, lysis x3, methanol extraction x3, LLE in isooctane x3, pooling, reconstitution, ELISA detect

compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations in s or m (h token unsupported by compiler)
known_compiler_bugs: drain lowered to dispose() in IR for both else-branches (bsbbif_3_f, bsbbif_6_f); .bs source is correct
True-branch blocks (bsbbif_2_t, bsbbif_5_t) emit no unconditional jump in IR text; DOT edges are correct
compiler_notes.fluid_ownership: All dispensed variables consumed exactly once; heat is void/in-place throughout
compiler_notes.lysis_abstraction: Paper uses 9x or 5x lysis cycles; 3 explicit cycles encoded (BioScript has no loop primitive); chemically representative
compiler_notes.extraction_abstraction: Paper uses 9x or 5x methanol cycles; 3 encoded; each cycle: dissolve in MeOH -> mix with isooctane -> heat 25c/20s (circulation) -> pooled
compiler_notes.lle_abstraction: isooctane modelled as a manifest; mix(dissolvedSample, isooctane) abstracts the electrode-driven translation into the isooctane pool; heat 25c for 20s abstracts the ~20 s circulation event
